name: Summarization Quality
description: Evaluates summaries on faithfulness, salient coverage, retrieval utility, and concision. Backs the built-in Summarization purpose template. Weights match R6: Faithfulness 0.40 / Salient Coverage 0.30 / Retrieval Utility 0.20 / Concision 0.10.

perspectives.name: Faithfulness
perspectives.description: No hallucinated facts not present in the source
perspectives.criteria: Does the summary avoid introducing facts, entities, or claims not present in the source content?
perspectives.scoringGuide: 1=Multiple fabrications, 2=Some fabrication, 3=Minor unsupported claims, 4=Faithful, 5=Perfectly faithful to source

perspectives.name: Salient Coverage
perspectives.description: The summary retains the source's key points
perspectives.criteria: Does the summary retain the key points and salient details of the source content?
perspectives.scoringGuide: 1=Misses the point entirely, 2=Misses major points, 3=Covers most key points, 4=Covers key points well, 5=Captures all salient points

perspectives.name: Retrieval Utility
perspectives.description: The summary would surface this memory for the queries a person would actually use to find it again
perspectives.criteria: Would this summary, indexed in a vector database, be retrieved by the natural-language queries someone would use to recall this memory later?
perspectives.scoringGuide: 1=Would not surface for any plausible query, 2=Surfaces only for very specific/unlikely queries, 3=Surfaces for some plausible queries, 4=Surfaces for most plausible queries, 5=Surfaces for essentially any plausible query about this memory

perspectives.name: Concision
perspectives.description: The summary is appropriately brief for the source content
perspectives.criteria: Is the summary concise, avoiding restating the source verbatim or padding with filler?
perspectives.scoringGuide: 1=As long as or longer than the source, 2=Barely condensed, 3=Reasonably condensed, 4=Concise, 5=Optimally concise
